title: LlmOnLan farm snapshot
description: What a farm advertises: the UDP beacon and GET /lol/self send this same object (farm/src/snapshot.js buildSnapshot). Required = what a client cannot work without; everything else is optional, because farms are updated by hand and the field runs mixed versions, and readers skip what they do not know. Checked by farm/test/run.js (a field missing here fails) and shell/test/chat/unit/farm-contract.test.mjs (the client reads today's farm, farm-v0.0.41 and the required fields alone).

v.description: Shape version, 1 since the first farm. The client's discovery and the coordinator's peer listener drop a snapshot without it.

id.description: The farm's stable id (farm/.lol-id). The client keys its farm list, the pin and stored passwords by it; the coordinator tells peers apart by it.

name.description: The farm's name. The client's farm cards, pill and list order; lol fleet.

proxyPort.description: The OpenAI port (the seat gate). The client builds Open WebUI's and LOL Vibe's base URL from the address it reached plus this port (farmSelect.ts farmEndpoint).

httpPort.description: Where /lol/self, /lol/plugin-keys and /lol/admin live. The client's polls and plugin-key fetch use it, else 41997 (discovery.ts, index.ts); without it the farm card hides Manage this farm (app.js) and no presence heartbeat is sent (index.ts).

ips.description: The farm's LAN addresses. The Farm app's reachable-at addresses, read from its own farm's /lol/self (farmSupervisor.ts), and lol up's banner; the client does not read them.

endpoint.description: The OpenAI root at the farm's primary address. The client files a beacon under this host (discovery.ts endpointHost).

openaiBaseUrl.description: endpoint + /v1. The coordinator routes to a peer through it (up.js); lol fleet prints it. The client builds its own from the address it reached.

requiresKey.description: A farm password is set. The client asks for it once and sends it as the Bearer; the coordinator skips such peers.

models.description: The served names (the /v1/models ids). The client's DEFAULT_MODELS and LOL Vibe's picker; the coordinator routes a peer's models.

id.description: The served name a chat binds to.

underlying.description: The real weights behind it. Farm cards and LOL Vibe's picker.

default.description: The model clients select by default (Open WebUI's DEFAULT_MODELS, LOL Vibe).

healthy.description: Proxy and engine are up. The client only connects to a healthy farm by itself; the coordinator skips unhealthy peers.

version.description: The Farm app's release (LOL_FARM_VERSION), else farm/package.json. lol fleet prints it.

coordinator.description: This farm balances its peers. The client prefers it (farmSelect.ts pickLeastLoaded); a coordinator never aggregates another.

searxngUrl.description: The shared SearXNG, null when off or down. Open WebUI's web search (configBridge.ts); the farm card's web search tag.

ttsUrl.description: The shared Kokoro, /v1 included, null when off or down. Open WebUI's AUDIO_TTS_* and the Computer's Speak box.

ttsVoice.description: Kokoro's voice. Open WebUI's AUDIO_TTS_VOICE (af_heart when null).

ttsModel.description: Kokoro's model. Open WebUI's AUDIO_TTS_MODEL (kokoro when null).

extract.description: The OCR loader. Open WebUI's EXTERNAL_DOCUMENT_LOADER_* and the Computer's Document box.

classify.description: The Laya service. The Computer's Classify box.

stt.description: Speech to text (POST {url}/v1/audio/transcriptions). The Computer's Sound box, in Listen mode.

embed.description: Document search, null when off or down (farms after farm-v0.0.43): POST {url}/v1/embeddings. Open WebUI's RAG_EMBEDDING_* and RAG_OPENAI_* (configBridge.ts), only when the client knows `contract`; on a farm with a password key is null and keyId names the key fetched from /lol/plugin-keys.

key.description: Its Bearer key; null on a farm with a password.

keyId.description: The start of the key's sha256, so a client knows when to fetch again.

model.description: The model name a request sends (embeddinggemma-2).

contract.description: Names the vectors (model, size, prefixes): a data folder keeps one contract for good (DATA_DIR/lol-embedding.json).

bus.description: The message bus, null when off or down. The Computer's Receive, Send and Trigger boxes talk to its WebSocket hub.

ws.description: ws://host:port, the hub the Computer uses (net/bus.mjs).

auth.description: The farm password is required on the bus. The password itself is never here.

plugins.description: Farm plugin states by id (websearch, tts, ocr, bus, embed, classify, stt), from registry.js pluginsSummary. The client's farm cards.

healthy.description: Running and answering; the card says starting otherwise.

recommendedClientPlugins.description: Client plugins the farm recommends (blender). The client turns one on unless a person chose (index.ts applyFarmRecommendations).

deployments.description: Balanced deployments behind the endpoint (hosts and peers). Farm cards and lol fleet.

health.description: Proxy and Ollama host detail. Farm cards (hosts up) and lol fleet.

host.description: The box's hardware, detected at boot ({ gpu, vramGb, ramGb, cpuCores }); its shape belongs to farm/src/systemInfo.js detectHardware. Farm cards (gpu, vramGb) and lol fleet.

usage.description: Live GPU use and connected clients. Farm cards; GPU % is the client's load figure for farms without capacity (farmSelect.ts farmLoad).

clients.description: Desktop clients heartbeating this farm (absent before presence).

backend.description: The engine that answers and its context window (absent before farm-v0.0.21). Farm cards; contextPerSlot sets Open WebUI's document mode (configBridge.ts) and LOL Vibe's context budget.

engine.description: Which engine serves (vllm: a vLLM the farm runs itself; external: a server the farm only routes to). Farm cards; the Computer's takes (no audio on Ollama).

alias.description: The served name of the default model.

baseUrl.description: External engine only: the server the farm routes to.

contextLength.description: The whole window; null until an automatic size is measured.

contextPerSlot.description: What one chat can count on when every seat is busy. The client's document mode and LOL Vibe's budget.

kvUnified.description: llama.cpp only: the seats share one context pool.

slotsVerified.description: false when slots is what the config asked for, not what the engine does.

capacity.description: Seats: slots and clients since farm-v0.0.21, busy and queued since v0.0.22, seatsUsed since the seat gate (v0.0.36), seatIdleSec since v0.0.38. The client's pill and cards, its least-busy pick, LOL Vibe's and the Computer's seat-aware sending.

seatsUsed.description: Seats held now; null when the seat gate is off.

seatIdleSec.description: A seat frees after this long without a generation; null when the gate is off.

busy.description: Requests generating now, when the engine reports it (llama.cpp, vLLM).

queued.description: Requests waiting, when the engine reports it.

mine.description: GET /lol/self only, since multi-user 1.6: the caller's address holds a seat. Never in the beacon; a client reads absent as no.

busy.description: The admin job in flight (a model switch, a download), null when none. Farm cards and LOL Vibe say why the farm went quiet.

label.description: What the card and LOL Vibe show.

perf.description: Measured speed on llama.cpp or an external vLLM, null otherwise; its shape belongs to farm/src/perf.js. The admin panel; LOL Vibe's strip reads lastGenTokSec.

ts.description: When the farm built this snapshot (ms). Informational.

service.description: A farm plugin's address and key, null when off or down. On a farm with a password key is null and keyId names the key a client fetches from /lol/plugin-keys.

key.description: Its Bearer key; null on a farm with a password.

keyId.description: The start of the key's sha256, so a client knows when to fetch again.
